newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-YANKEES' WORLD SERIES BONUS SHARE IS $216,000 EACH.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-YANKEES' WORLD SERIES BONUS SHARE IS $216,000 EACH.

text.p: The New York Yankees collected a record winners' share of $216,870.08 apiece out of the playoffs bonus pool for their 1996 World Series triumph over the Atlanta Braves, Major League Baseball announced on Monday.

The Yankees, who divided up nearly $9.2 million, allotted 28 full shares plus nine half-shares, seven quarter-shares and nine cash grants to uniformed personnel. Six full shares and other lesser awards were given to non-uniformed personnel.
The previous record winners' share was $206,635.01 distributed last year by Atlanta.

The Braves received more than $6.1 million and voted 33 full shares of $143,678.36 plus six half-shares, one third-share, six quarter-shares and five cash grants to uniformed personnel. Four full shares and other lesser awards went to non-uniformed personnel.
The players' pool of nearly $25.5 million surpassed the previous high of $22.17 million distributed in 1995.

The pool is formed from 80 percent of the gate receipts from the first three games of the Division Series and 60 percent of the gate receipts from the first four games of the League Championship Series and World Series. It was divided among 12 clubs.
